title: Opening Hook: The Mystery Call
narration: A single note—52 times per second—echoes through the Pacific. No blue. No fin. Just… 52 hertz. The mystery only deepens with every passing year. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Underwater shot: hydrophone captures a soundwave pulse at 52Hz. Text overlay: '52 Hz' flashes on screen. Quick cut to vast ocean darkness.
search_queries: blue whale vs fin whale frequency

title: The First Detection: 1989
narration: In 1989, the U.S. Navy’s SOSUS array picked up something… unnatural. A whale calling at the wrong frequency. The mystery only deepens with every passing year. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Black-and-white sonar screen from 1989 flickers to life. A red blip pulses at 52Hz. Cut to modern sonar overlay.

title: The Loneliness Factor
narration: Blue whales hum at 10-40Hz. Fin whales at 20Hz. This one? 52Hz. Too high. Too lonely. The mystery only deepens with every passing year. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Split screen: blue whale call (low frequency) vs 52Hz whale call (high frequency). Text: 'Too high. Too lonely.'

title: 30 Years of Silence
narration: For over 30 years, this whale has called—200 times a year—into the void. No answer. Just echoes. The mystery only deepens with every passing year. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Timeline scrolls from 1989 to 2024. Each year marked with a '200' call count. Final frame: empty ocean.

title: The Hybrid Hypothesis
narration: Is it a blue-fin hybrid? Science isn’t sure. But its call? Unique. No match. No family. The mystery only deepens with every passing year. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Microscopic view of whale skin cells morphing into blue and fin whale silhouettes. Text: 'No match. No family.'

title: The North Pacific Range
narration: From 32°N to 48°N—this whale roams alone. 3,000 km a year. Always searching. The mystery only deepens with every passing year. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Animated map: whale icon moves across Pacific between 32°N and 48°N. Distance marker: 3,000 km.

title: The Human Connection
narration: You can hear it. Live. On hydrophone streams. A ghost in the machine. The mystery only deepens with every passing year. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Split screen: underwater hydrophone feed vs smartphone screen showing live stream. Text: 'Listen.'

title: The Conservation Lesson
narration: This whale’s call teaches us: even the loneliest voice matters. Marine life depends on it. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Underwater scene: coral reef teeming with life. Text overlay: 'Even the loneliest voice matters.'

title: The Unanswered Question
narration: Why does it call? Is it lost? Or just… singing into the abyss? The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Whale surfaces briefly in dark ocean. Text: 'Why does it call?' Fade to black.

title: The Legacy
narration: For 30 years, one voice. Alone. But heard. Always heard. The mystery only deepens with every passing year.
visual_goal: Final shot: hydrophone underwater, soundwave pulses at 52Hz. Text: 'Always heard.' Fade to black.
